title: Jeffrey Epstein Born
body:
Jeffrey Edward Epstein born January 20, 1953, in Brooklyn, New York. His parents were working-class Jewish immigrants. He attended Lafayette High School in Brooklyn.

---

title: Epstein Hired at Dalton School
body:
Epstein, who did not complete a college degree, was hired as a math and physics teacher at the Dalton School in Manhattan. He met investment banker Alan "Ace" Greenberg's son there, creating the social connection that would launch his finance career.

---

title: Epstein Joins Bear Stearns
body:
Through the Greenberg connection, Epstein was hired at Bear Stearns, eventually rising to limited partner by 1980. He left under disputed circumstances circa 1981 — officially for violating SEC regulations regarding client funds.

---

title: J. Epstein & Co. Founded
body:
After leaving Bear Stearns, Epstein founded J. Epstein & Co., presenting himself as an exclusive financial advisor who would only accept clients with $1 billion or more in assets. The claimed strategy involved sophisticated tax and asset protection structures. In reality, his primary client was Wexner.

---

title: Alleged Assault of Approximately 13-Year-Old
body:
**[UNVERIFIED — DOJ explicitly labeled this claim false]** An FBI memo details a woman's claim that around 1983, when she was approximately 13, Epstein introduced her to Trump, who she alleged sexually assaulted her. The FBI interviewed this woman four times (first interview July 24, 2019). Per NPR's February 24, 2026 investigation, only the first interview is publicly available; 53 pages of interview materials appear to be missing by cross-referencing serial numbers against FBI case records. Her attorney said she "was concerned about implicating additional individuals, and specifically any that were well known, due to fear of retaliation." The DOJ labeled these claims "untrue and sensationalist claims submitted to the FBI right before the 2020 election." [DISCREPANCY between DOJ's characterization and NPR's serial number analysis finding missing documents]

---

title: Wexner-Epstein Money Management Relationship Begins
body:
Wexner hired Epstein as his exclusive money manager in the mid-1980s. Wexner had built the L Brands empire (Limited Stores, Victoria's Secret, Bath & Body Works). The relationship would become the foundation of Epstein's claimed wealth.

---

title: Austrian Passport Issued
body:
An Austrian passport under the alias **"Marius Robert Fortelni"** listing a Saudi Arabian address was issued to Epstein in 1987. This document was released in Dataset 8 of the DOJ files. The existence of a foreign-name passport with a Saudi residence raises intelligence-connection questions that remain unresolved.

---

title: Trump and Epstein Meet
body:
A New York Times piece ("A 15-Year Bond Between Trump and Epstein," July 20, 2025) dated their friendship to the late 1980s, describing the relationship as social and business-adjacent. Jack O'Donnell, former Trump Plaza COO, stated that in the late 1980s, he reprimanded both Trump and Epstein when they brought girls under New Jersey's legal gambling age of 21 onto the Trump casino floor. O'Donnell previously wrote about a similar incident (with Epstein's name omitted by his publisher) in his 1991 book *Trumped!*

---

title: Wexner Power of Attorney Granted
body:
Wexner granted Epstein a sweeping power of attorney giving him "full power and authority to do and perform every act necessary" over finances, investments, and property. This legal instrument enabled Epstein to transfer assets from Wexner to himself. A 1998 purchase/sale agreement, a $10 million promissory note, and a personal guaranty signed by Epstein — detailing the Manhattan townhouse transfer mechanics — were released in the January 30, 2026 DOJ dump.

---

title: Larry (Lawrence) Visoski Hired as Pilot
body:
Visoski was hired in approximately 1991 and eventually became chief pilot, replacing David Rodgers. He testified at the Maxwell trial in December 2021, confirming Trump as a passenger on Epstein's aircraft.

---

title: Little St. James Island Purchased
body:
Epstein purchased Little St. James Island in the U.S. Virgin Islands, approximately 70 acres. The island would become the primary location for trafficking operations. Flight logs, boat trip logs, and an island logbook were seized by the FBI. House Oversight released 73 photos and 4 videos from the island in December 2025.

---

title: Mar-a-Lago "Calendar Girl Competition"
body:
George Houraney organized a "calendar girl competition" at Mar-a-Lago in 1992 or 1993 where Trump and Epstein were the only two male VIP guests among approximately 28 young women. This event provides documented social overlap between Trump and Epstein in the context of young women.

---

title: First Documented Trump-Epstein Flight
body:
A 1993 flight in which only Trump and Epstein were listed as passengers is among the documented flight records. This is the first of at least 8 flights between 1993 and 1996.

---

title: Zorro Ranch, New Mexico Purchased
body:
Epstein purchased Zorro Ranch (approximately 7,600–10,000 acres) near Stanley, New Mexico, in 1993, from the family of Governor Bruce King, for approximately $12 million, through a shell company called "Zorro Trust" (later renamed Cypress, Inc.). The ranch became a site of abuse and was the location of Epstein's transhumanist "impregnation" plans. Sold August 2023 to San Rafael Ranch LLC (Don Huffines family).

---

title: Jane / Interlochen Victim Recruited
body:
A girl recruited by Epstein at the Interlochen Center for the Arts summer camp in Michigan at approximately age 13–14. She later testified at Maxwell's 2021 trial under the pseudonym "Jane." In her FBI 302 interview, she stated Epstein introduced her to Trump at Mar-a-Lago: "This is a good one, right?" Trump "smiled and nodded." She did not describe inappropriate behavior by Trump in her trial testimony. Epstein donated $200,000 to Interlochen establishing the "Epstein Scholarship Lodge." Her FBI interview was temporarily removed from DOJ files and republished February 19, 2026. Her mother's interview (recalling hearing "a prince and DONALD TRUMP visited EPSTEIN's house") remains offline as of February 24, 2026.

---

title: Trump-Epstein Flight with Marla Maples
body:
Documented flight from Palm Beach to Teterboro via D.C. with Trump, Marla Maples, and infant Tiffany Trump aboard. This is among the specifically dated flights in the public record.

---

title: Trump-Epstein Flight with Eric Trump and Maxwell
body:
Documented flight from Palm Beach to Teterboro with Eric Trump and Maxwell present alongside Epstein and Trump.

---

title: Maria Farmer Reports Epstein to FBI
body:
Maria Farmer reported Epstein to the FBI in 1996 — more than 20 years before he faced federal charges. CBS independently obtained a 1996 NYPD report in which she described threats from Epstein after she was abused at his Manhattan residence. The 1996 complaint was categorized as a child pornography case and went uninvestigated for over a decade.

---

title: MC2 Model Management Operations
body:
Jean-Luc Brunel operated MC2 Model Management with up to $1 million in Epstein funding. A former MC2 bookkeeper told the FBI in 2010 that Brunel flew in teenage models from around the world, housed them in Epstein's Upper East Side apartments, and "loaned them out to wealthy clients for up to $100,000 a night."

---

title: Trump-Epstein Flight to Newark
body:
Documented flight from Palm Beach to Newark. Among the specifically dated Trump-Epstein flights.

---

title: Flight Log Period with Full Manifests
body:
The 118-page handwritten flight logs (entered as Maxwell trial evidence, signed by pilot David Rodgers, covering 1991–2006) are the most complete passenger record. The logs cover February 1997 through 2006 with full passenger names. After August 2013, no passenger manifests exist despite 835 documented flights through Epstein's 2019 arrest.

Key passenger frequencies (per DOJ Files supplement and GH):
- Maxwell: ~400–520 legs
- Sarah Kellen: ~338–364 legs
- Emmy Tayler: ~190 legs
- Nadia Marcinkova: ~110 legs
- Lesley Groff: ~82 legs
- Virginia Giuffre: 48 legs
- Eva Andersson Dubin: ~36 legs
- Jean-Luc Brunel: 20–34 legs
- Prince Andrew: 25 legs
- Les Wexner: 15 legs
- Bill Clinton: 26 legs (2002–2003 concentrated)
- Donald Trump: at least 8 domestic flights (1993–1996)

---

title: JPMorgan Account Opened
body:
Epstein opened what would become his primary JPMorgan account around 1998. JPMorgan ultimately maintained 134 accounts for Epstein from 1998 to 2013. By 2009, Epstein had $142M+ in balances, putting him on JPMorgan's "Wall of Cash" list. The bank filed only 7 SARs totaling $4.3 million while Epstein was alive — compared to 4,700 transactions totaling $1.1–1.3 billion flagged retroactively after his death.

---

title: Harvard Donations ($9.1 Million Total)
body:
Epstein donated $6.5 million in 2003 to establish Harvard's Program for Evolutionary Dynamics under Martin Nowak, with total gifts reaching $9.1 million (1998–2008). Epstein introduced donors who gave $7.5 million to Nowak's work and $2 million to George Church's genomics lab. Despite a 2008 Harvard ban on Epstein gifts, Nowak gave him unrestricted key card access to Harvard offices as late as 2018.

---

title: Palm Beach Mansion Acquired
body:
Epstein acquired the Palm Beach mansion at 358 El Brillo Way (some sources list 360 El Brillo Way — **[DISCREPANCY in address]**) around 1999. The property sat approximately 2 miles north of Mar-a-Lago and would become the primary site of the Palm Beach abuse operation. Palm Beach Police identified 27 girls and women aged 14–23 who visited Epstein's home for "massage services."

---

title: Virginia Giuffre Recruited at Mar-a-Lago
body:
Virginia Giuffre, then 16, was recruited by Maxwell while working as a spa attendant at Trump's Mar-a-Lago club in Palm Beach. Maxwell approached her and offered a job as a "massage therapist" for Epstein. Giuffre has 48 documented flight log entries from the subsequent years.

---

title: Giuffre-Andrew Photo Developed
body:
The authenticated photograph of Giuffre with Prince Andrew and Maxwell at Maxwell's London townhouse was developed on March 13, 2001, at a Florida Walgreens. This photo became a central Maxwell trial exhibit. Andrew's arm is around Giuffre's waist; both are smiling; Maxwell stands behind them. Andrew challenged the photo's authenticity; authentication was affirmed.

---

title: Clinton's 26 Flight Legs
body:
Flight logs show Clinton on Epstein's Boeing 727 for at least 26 flight legs (16+ distinct flights) across trips to Bangkok, Brunei, Rwanda, Russia, China, and Africa. Maxwell's initials ("GM") appear on each trip. Clinton traveled without Secret Service on at least five flight legs.

---

title: Melania Trump Email to Maxwell
body:
Melania Trump emailed Maxwell (EFTA02332411): "Dear G! How are you? Nice story about JE in NY mag. You look great in the picture… Give me a call when you are back in NY." Maxwell replied warmly, calling her "Sweet pea." A Tatler magazine image in the files showed Maxwell, Donald Trump, and Melania together. A witness noted "Ghislaine looks very much like Melania" (EFTA00032417). Handwritten notes by girls asked to massage Epstein mention someone introducing Melania to Trump (EFTA00105195). Epstein told Nikolic "your friend Melani, really nuts" (EFTA02651268). Wolff told Epstein that journalists were "working a lead on a Melania boyfriend OY"; Epstein replied "makes sense" (EFTA02553567). Bannon texted: "Melania? Not living with him." (EFTA01615888) No direct allegations of criminal conduct against Melania Trump are documented. Released in Dataset 9 of the DOJ files.

---

title: Clinton-Epstein-Maxwell Flight Network
body:
Clinton's black book entry lists four phone numbers; aide Doug Band listed with two. The concentrated flight period 2002–2003 includes international trips to developing nations, often described publicly as Clinton Foundation humanitarian work.

---

title: "Birthday Book" for Epstein's 50th Birthday
body:
Maxwell compiled a birthday book for Epstein's 50th birthday in 2003. The Wall Street Journal (July 17, 2025 story by Safdar and Palazzolo) reported that a letter bearing Trump's name contained "several lines of typewritten text framed by the outline of a naked woman" with Trump's signature "mimicking pubic hair," concluding: "Happy Birthday — and may every day be another wonderful secret." Trump called it "a FAKE." House Oversight released the actual letter in September 2025, confirming the WSJ's description.

---

title: Harvard Program for Evolutionary Dynamics Founded
body:
Epstein donated $6.5 million to establish Harvard's Program for Evolutionary Dynamics under Martin Nowak.

---

title: Trump Outbids Epstein for Maison de l'Amitié
body:
Trump outbid Epstein to purchase the Palm Beach mansion Maison de l'Amitié in 2004 for $41.35 million. Epstein reportedly viewed this as a betrayal. Epstein later emailed journalist Michael Wolff that he believed Trump was "fronting for someone else" in the purchase. In 2008, Trump sold it to Russian oligarch Dmitry Rybolovlev for $95 million.

---

title: Palm Beach Police Investigation Opens
body:
Palm Beach Police Department opened an investigation after a parent reported that Epstein had paid her 14-year-old daughter for massages. Chief Michael Reiter led the investigation. By the end of the investigation, police had identified 27 girls and women between ages 14 and 23 who had visited Epstein's home for "massage services." Palm Beach detectives built a case independently and referred it to the State Attorney's Office before eventually escalating to federal authorities.

---

title: Adriana Ross Removes Computers Before Warrant
body:
Former butler Janusz Banasiak testified that Adriana Ross and an associate removed computers from Epstein's Palm Beach mansion weeks before police executed a search warrant in October 2005.

---

title: FBI Involvement Begins
body:
The Palm Beach investigation was referred to the FBI and the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of Florida, then led by Alex Acosta. AUSA Marie Villafaña became the lead federal prosecutor. FBI grand jury testimony from May 2007 (released December 5, 2025) described Epstein's grooming methods with the youngest victim described as 14 years old.

---

title: Trump Calls Palm Beach Police Chief
body:
Former Palm Beach Police Chief Michael Reiter told the FBI in an October 2019 interview that Trump called him in July 2006 saying: "Thank goodness you're stopping him, everyone has known he's been doing this." Trump also told Reiter that Maxwell was Epstein's "operative" and was "evil." This directly contradicts Trump's July 2019 public statement that he "had no idea" about Epstein's conduct. **[DISCREPANCY: Trump's 2006 call to Reiter vs. Trump's 2019 "no idea" public statement]**

---

title: Draft Federal Indictment Prepared
body:
AUSA Marie Villafaña prepared a 53-page draft federal indictment with 60 criminal counts by May 2007. The draft would have charged Epstein alongside three unnamed co-defendants (employees) and two Epstein-owned companies, alleging conspiracy from 2001–2005 to "procure females under the age of 18." A companion 45-page prosecution memo addressed to Acosta described Epstein as "an extremely high flight risk and a continued danger to the community" and recommended a sealed indictment. The indictment was marked with a handwritten note "old draft" and was unsigned by Acosta. **[DISCREPANCY: CBS says 32-count draft indictment with 19 Jane Does; Beyond Existing Research says "32-to-60-count" draft; DOJ Files supplement says 53-page draft with 60 criminal counts]** — these may reference different versions of the draft.

---

title: Non-Prosecution Agreement Signed
body:
The NPA was signed on September 24, 2007 — one day before Villafaña was prepared to file the indictment. The agreement granted immunity to Epstein, four named co-conspirators (Kellen, Groff, Marcinkova, Ross), and "any potential co-conspirators." The full NPA text is on DocumentCloud at documentcloud.org/documents/6184602-Jeffrey-Epstein-non-prosecution-agreement/. The DOJ Office of Professional Responsibility report found Acosta's handling was "poor judgment" but not "professional misconduct." Acosta later told the Trump transition vetting team he was told Epstein "belonged to intelligence" with a "leave-it-alone" status — which Acosta denied under oath.

---

title: Epstein Expelled from Mar-a-Lago
body:
Mar-a-Lago records show Epstein's account was "closed" around October 2007, approximately a year after his 2006 indictment. **[DISCREPANCY: Four different accounts exist for the Mar-a-Lago ban; see Appendix E]**

---

title: Florida State Grand Jury Prosecutors Question Victims About "Prostitution"
body:
Florida state grand jury transcripts (released July 1, 2024, after Florida HB 117 created an exemption to grand jury secrecy) reveal prosecutors knew Epstein had raped girls as young as 14, two years before the plea deal. Prosecutors questioned teenage victims by asking them to acknowledge they had committed "prostitution." The transcripts are approximately 150 pages.

---

title: Epstein Convicted, Sentenced to 18 Months
body:
Under the NPA, Epstein pleaded guilty to state charges of soliciting a minor for prostitution in Palm Beach County. He was sentenced to 18 months in the Palm Beach County Jail, with permission for work release 12 hours a day, 6 days a week.

---

title: Harvard Bans Epstein Donations
body:
Harvard officially banned future Epstein donations in 2008 following his conviction. Despite this ban, Martin Nowak continued to give Epstein unrestricted key card access to Harvard offices as late as 2018.

---

title: JPMorgan Relationship Continues Post-Conviction
body:
JPMorgan maintained Epstein's 134 accounts through 2013, filing no SARs between 2003 and 2008 during peak trafficking activity. Mary Erdoes was in "constant contact" with Epstein; executive John Duffy counseled Epstein on evading cash reporting requirements. JPMorgan settled with victims for $290 million in 2023.

---

title: Deutsche Bank Relationship Begins Planning
body:
Deutsche Bank opened 40+ accounts for Epstein from August 2013 (immediately after the JPMorgan relationship ended) through mid-2019, classifying Epstein as "high-risk" from onboarding but maintaining the relationship for five years. NYDFS fined Deutsche Bank $150 million in July 2020.

---

title: Epstein Released from Jail
body:
Epstein completed his 18-month sentence and was released. He registered as a sex offender in Florida and New York. His post-conviction networking accelerated almost immediately.

---

title: Alfredo Rodriguez FBI Sting
body:
A 46-minute FBI sting operation video shows Epstein's former house manager Alfredo Rodriguez attempting to sell the "little black book" for $50,000 to an undercover FBI agent. Rodriguez described it as the "Holy Grail" and claimed Maxwell maintained a computer database of nude photos. Rodriguez was convicted of obstruction of justice and sentenced to 18 months; he died in 2014. The video was released in DOJ files and was initially mislabeled as a PDF file — discoverable by changing the file extension to .mp4 (a discovery made by r/Epstein community researchers).

---

title: Brad Edwards Interviews Trump
body:
Attorney Brad Edwards (representing Epstein victims) interviewed Trump about his connections to Epstein. Trump was "very helpful" and "gave no indication whatsoever that he was involved in anything untoward." A 2009 email summarizing the call (reviewed by Rep. Jamie Raskin in 2025) quoted Trump as saying Epstein "was not a member of his club at Mar-a-Lago, but he was a guest, and he had never been asked to leave" — contradicting Trump's later public claims of having expelled Epstein. **[DISCREPANCY: 2009 email summary vs. Trump's post-2019 public statements]**

---

title: Sarah Ferguson "Brother I Never Had" Emails
body:
2009 emails from Ferguson to Epstein called him "the brother I have always wished for."

---

title: Adriana Ross Fifth Amendment Deposition
body:
Ross invoked the Fifth Amendment over 100 times in her March 2010 deposition. When asked about Sandy Berger allegedly tipping off Epstein about a raid, she invoked the Fifth. Her testimony was part of civil litigation arising from the original case.

---

title: Epstein Fifth Amendment Deposition (Edwards v. Epstein)
body:
In a deposition in Edwards v. Epstein on March 17, 2010, Epstein invoked his Fifth, Sixth, and 14th Amendment rights when asked: "Have you ever socialized with Donald Trump in the presence of females under the age of 18?" He invoked the Fifth over 1,000 times across his depositions, including about Clinton, Prince Andrew, and Maxwell. A 34-second video clip of the Trump question went viral in July 2025.

---

title: DEA Investigation Opened
body:
A previously undisclosed DEA investigation ("Operation Chain Reaction") was opened on December 17, 2010, targeting Epstein and 14 other individuals for suspicious wire transfers linked to narcotics and prostitution. The 69-page memo documented approximately $50 million in suspicious wire transfers and identified Epstein bank accounts in Switzerland, France, the Cayman Islands, and New York. SDNY prosecutors who later charged Epstein in 2019 told CBS they were not aware of the earlier DEA probe.

---

title: First Gates-Epstein Meeting (Post-Conviction)
body:
Epstein's first meeting with Bill Gates after the 2008 conviction took place in December 2010. A December 1–3, 2010 scheduling email from Lesley Groff confirms coordination. Groff simultaneously coordinated meetings with Jes Staley and Leon Black during the same period.

---

title: Groff Schedules Gates, Staley, Black Meetings Simultaneously
body:
Three days of scheduling emails (December 1–3, 2010) show Groff coordinating meetings with Jes Staley, Bill Gates, and Leon Black simultaneously. This period demonstrates the breadth of post-conviction networking.

---

title: Epstein-Gates Seattle Invitation Email
body:
A February 2011 email from Epstein reads: "You and I are invited to Seattle to spend serious time with Bill Gates."

---

title: Gates-Epstein Meeting
body:
An April 2011 scheduling email from Lesley Groff to Larry Summers describes a Gates dinner at Epstein's New York residence. A second meeting occurred in October 2011.

---

title: Epstein "Dog That Hasn't Barked" Email to Maxwell
body:
Epstein wrote to Maxwell: "I want you to realize that that dog that hasn't barked is trump. [VICTIM] spent hours at my house with him, he has never once been mentioned. police chief. etc. im 75% there." Maxwell replied: "I have been thinking about that." House Oversight released this email on November 12, 2025. House Republicans identified the redacted victim as Virginia Giuffre — which would contradict Giuffre's sworn testimony (November 2016) that she never saw Trump at Epstein's homes. **[DISCREPANCY: Epstein email vs. Giuffre sworn deposition testimony]**

---

title: Gates-Epstein Meeting (Norway)
body:
Gates-Epstein meeting documented for October 2011, and separately for August 2012 (Norway).

---

title: JPMorgan Relationship Ends / Deutsche Bank Begins
body:
JPMorgan ended its relationship with Epstein in 2013 (exact month varies by source). **[DISCREPANCY: Some sources say JPMorgan relationship ended in 2013, others in early 2013]**. Deutsche Bank opened 40+ accounts for Epstein beginning in August 2013 — immediately after the JPMorgan relationship ended. Attorney Darren Indyke made 97 cash withdrawals of exactly $7,500 from Deutsche Bank accounts — textbook structuring — occurring 2–3 times monthly from 2013 to 2017.

---

title: Howard Lutnick Island Visit
body:
Island visitor logs confirm Howard Lutnick visited Little St. James with his family on approximately December 23, 2012. This directly contradicts Lutnick's public claim that he cut ties with Epstein in 2005. CBS News also reported that Lutnick co-signed business documents with Epstein for "Adfin" in December 2012.

---

title: Deutsche Bank Accounts Opened
body:
Deutsche Bank opened 40+ accounts for Epstein starting August 2013, classified as "high-risk" from onboarding. The Butterfly Trust account specifically funded 120+ wire transfers totaling $2.65M to beneficiaries including women with Eastern European surnames for "hotel expenses, tuition, and rent."

---

title: Elon Musk Island Calendar Entry
body:
A Google Calendar entry in Dataset 9 reads "ELON MUSK TO ISLAND DEC. 6TH" for December 6, 2013. 2012–2014 emails about island visits are documented in the DOJ files along with a "wildest party" exchange. **[UNVERIFIED — Musk has denied visiting the island]**

---

title: Leon Black Payments Begin
body:
The Senate Finance Committee (Wyden) documented payments from Black to Epstein beginning 2013: $23.5 million under a signed service agreement, and an additional $56.5 million under an unsigned second contract. Payments averaged approximately $8 million per wire, sent to Southern Trust Company and Financial Trust Company Inc.

title: Black-Epstein $70M Payment (No Written Agreement)
body:
2014 payment timeline: $70 million in 2014 on an ad hoc basis with no written agreement. [DISCREPANCY in timing: DOJ supplement says 2014 for the $70M; overall Black payments are 2013–2017]

title: Barak and Barak-Summers Recording
body:
A 3.5-hour 2014 audio recording of a Barak-Summers conversation discussing immigration was published from the DOJ files. Barak had multiple documented island visits in 2014–2015.

---

title: Epstein Arranges Barak-Thiel Meeting
body:
A meeting between Barak and Peter Thiel was arranged by Epstein in June 2014.

---

title: Reid Hoffman and Joi Ito Visit Island
body:
Confirmed visit to Little St. James by Reid Hoffman and Joi Ito in November 2014, documented in scheduling records.

---

title: Leon Black Payments ($30 Million)
body:
$30 million paid by Black to Epstein in 2015. Continued the pattern from 2013–2014.

---

title: $25 Million Rothschild Contract Signed
body:
Epstein, through Southern Trust, signed a $25 million contract with Edmond de Rothschild Holding S.A. for "risk analysis and algorithm-related services." The contract was signed by Ariane de Rothschild. Payment was triggered when the Rothschild Group completed a $45.2 million penalty under the DOJ's Swiss Bank Program for helping U.S. clients hide undeclared assets.

---

title: Rothschild Wires Hit Epstein Accounts
body:
Wires totaling $25 million hit Epstein's accounts on December 17 and 21, 2015 — concurrent with the Rothschild Group completing its DOJ settlement.

---

title: Epstein-Wolff "Hang Him" Exchange
body:
In December 2015, Wolff advised Epstein: "If he says he hasn't been on the plane or to the house, then that gives you a valuable PR and political currency. You can hang him in a way that potentially generates a positive benefit for you." CNN had planned to ask Trump about Epstein at a debate; Wolff suggested letting Trump "hang himself." CNN did not ask the question.

---

title: Epstein Offers Trump-Girls Photos to NYT Reporter
body:
Epstein emailed NYT reporter Landon Thomas Jr. offering: "would you like to see photos of donald and girls in bikinis in my kitchen." Thomas replied "Yes!!!" Epstein then described Lauren Petrella ("Hawaiian tropic girl") and Celina Midelfart, describing Midelfart as "my 20 year old girlfriend in 93, that after two years i gave to donald."

title: Surveillance Equipment Installed in Barak's Apartment
body:
A January 2016 email chain shows Rafi Shlomo (director of protective service at the Israeli mission to the UN) coordinating with Epstein's staff to install surveillance equipment at the 301 East 66th Street apartment, including window sensors and remote access capabilities. Priell wrote: "They can neutralize the system from far." Epstein replied: "Jeffrey says he does not mind holes in the walls and this is all just fine!"

---

title: "Katie Johnson" Lawsuit Filed and Forwarded to Barrack
body:
The first "Katie Johnson" civil lawsuit was filed on April 26, 2016, in C.D. California. Epstein forwarded Barrack an email about the lawsuit writing it was "nuts but I thought you guys should know." Barrack replied "on the bosses list." The lawsuit was re-filed twice (June 2016 in S.D.N.Y.; September 2016 in SDNY with attorneys and affidavits). Withdrawn November 4, 2016 after plaintiff received threats.

---

title: Maxwell Videotaped Deposition (Giuffre v. Maxwell)
body:
Maxwell's confidential April 22, 2016 videotaped deposition was taken in the Giuffre v. Maxwell case. Contents were the subject of years of legal battles over unsealing. The deposition was eventually made public as part of the January 2024 unsealing orders.

---

title: Epstein Alerts Ruemmler About Brunel's Cooperation Plans
body:
Epstein learned of Brunel's planned cooperation with federal prosecutors and alerted Kathy Ruemmler, claiming someone demanded "$3 million so that Jean Luc would not go in." Brunel went silent thereafter.

---

title: Epstein-Chopra $10,000 Baby Bet Exchange
body:
Chopra asked: "Do you know Marla Maples?" Epstein replied: "Yes, In fact when she told donald she was pregnant. I lost a 10k dollar bet with him, and sent him a truck of baby food in payment."

---

title: Barrack-Barak-Churkin Lunch Calendar Entry
body:
Epstein's calendar shows a lunch at his house with Barrack, Barak, and Russian UN Ambassador Vitaly Churkin on August 29, 2016. The day after this lunch, Epstein purchased approximately $1 million in Colony Capital stock — Barrack's publicly traded real estate company.

---

title: Katie Johnson Lawsuit Dismissed
body:
The third "Katie Johnson" filing was voluntarily dismissed on November 4, 2016 — six days before the election. Lisa Bloom stated the plaintiff received "a number of threats" and was "too afraid." Attorney Goldman said "Johnson's car and cellphone were stolen."

---

title: Virginia Giuffre Deposition (Giuffre v. Maxwell)
body:
In her November 2016 deposition in Giuffre v. Maxwell: "Have you ever been in Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein's presence with one another?" — "No." "Did you ever see Donald Trump at Jeffrey's home?" — "Not that I can remember." "Donald Trump never flirted with me." "I don't think Donald Trump participated in anything." These are the strongest exculpatory statements regarding Trump from any victim.

---

title: 86-Page SDNY Co-Conspirators Memo
body:
The 86-page SDNY memo "Investigation into Potential Co-Conspirators of Jeffrey Epstein" was sent to U.S. Attorney Geoffrey Berman on December 19, 2019. **[DISCREPANCY: source file says December 19, 2019 (sent to Berman); separately the memo is dated December 2019 — confirmed post-arrest year]** It contains statements from 24 women abused as minors and 14 abused as adults. It evaluated potential charges against Maxwell, Groff, and others. The DOJ initially posted then reportedly removed it — it was preserved and republished.

---

title: Black Final Payment to Epstein ($8 Million)
body:
A final $8 million payment was made by Black to Epstein in April 2017. Black also made $22.5 million and $8 million loans to Epstein in early 2017 via BV70 LLC → Plan D LLC; Epstein repaid only $10 million before his death.

---

title: Epstein Tips Wolff: "Tillerson Probably Leaving"
body:
**EFTA:** EFTA02637845

On August 20, 2017, Epstein texted Wolff: "Tillerson probably leaving, Ivanka wants Nikki Haley" — passing White House political intelligence to a journalist. Rex Tillerson was indeed fired in March 2018. This documents Epstein's access to White House personnel decisions before they were publicly known.

---

title: Bannon-Epstein Introduction
body:
Bannon and Epstein were introduced in December 2017. Their extensive communication relationship (hundreds of texts and emails) began shortly thereafter.

---

title: Bannon-Miro-Epstein Saturday Lunch
body:
**EFTA:** EFTA02240153

In late March 2018, Epstein arranged a Saturday lunch bringing together Steve Bannon and Miroslav Lajčák, who was then serving as President of the UN General Assembly. This was part of a documented pattern of Epstein using his access to senior UN officials to facilitate meetings with political operatives and business contacts.

---

title: Miro-Bannon-Epstein Dinner; Sultan Meets Ross and McAleenan
body:
**EFTA:** EFTA02245731

On April 25, 2018 at 7:15 PM, Epstein hosted a dinner with UN General Assembly President Miroslav Lajčák and Steve Bannon. The email documenting this dinner also notes that Sultan bin Sulayem — DP World CEO and UAE government figure who appears 4,700+ times in Epstein's files — was simultaneously visiting Washington DC and had meetings scheduled with U.S. Secretary of Commerce Wilbur Ross and CBP Commissioner Kevin McAleenan. body:

title: Autopsy Performed
body:
Dr. Roman initially listed the manner of death as "pending" rather than suicide. Mark Epstein stated she told the family the injuries "looked too much like a homicide." Dr. Michael Baden, present at the autopsy, found three fractures: left and right thyroid cartilage and the left hyoid bone — each with hemorrhage. In 50+ years and 1,000+ jail hangings, he had "never seen three fractures" in a suicidal hanging. The ligature furrow mark was in the middle of Epstein's neck rather than beneath the jawbone as expected in hanging. Petechiae (burst capillaries) on the face, mouth, and eyes were more consistent with strangulation. Baden concluded the evidence pointed "much more to murder and strangulation than suicide."

title: New Mexico AG Reopens Zorro Ranch Criminal Investigation
body:
New Mexico AG Raúl Torrez reopened the criminal investigation into Epstein's activities at Zorro Ranch in February 2026. The New Mexico legislature simultaneously passed legislation for a full bipartisan "truth commission" with subpoena power. DOJ files contain anonymous allegations of bodies buried on the property. The New Mexico Supreme Court ruled DOJ had to hand over its Epstein files to the state. [epstein_themes_synthesis.md]

title: Reuters/CNN Polling on Public Confidence in Epstein Case
body:
December 2025 Reuters poll: Only **23%** of respondents approved of Trump's handling of the Epstein case — one of the lowest approval marks on any issue. January 2026 CNN poll: 49% were dissatisfied with the volume of documents released; **two-thirds** (approximately 67%) said the government was deliberately withholding information. These numbers reflect widespread public skepticism about the sufficiency of the EFTA disclosure process. [epstein_themes_synthesis.md]

title: The Economist/JMail LLM Alarm Index
body:
The Economist partnered with Jmail (jmail.world) to produce an LLM-scored "alarm index" of all 1,038,603 Epstein emails in the JMail database, systematically flagging the most disturbing threads — including requests for nude photos from women with redacted names and references to avoiding parents. This collaboration represents the most systematic machine-learning application to the Epstein archive. JMail provides a Gmail-clone interface to the full email archive and supports search, tagging, and export functions for community researchers. [epstein_themes_synthesis.md]
